summary: The exact two-input_text array already succeeds on the recorded base and the candidate adds regression tests only. OpenAI's declared output-list contract also permits image and file parts; independent schema-valid cases show those parts are silently discarded, and the candidate explicitly locks image loss in as expected behavior.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-55e34908484f/venv/bin/python -c '<validate exact issue payload and normalize each input item>'
tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, ResponsesRequest accepted the exact issue payload and the checked-out serving source normalized the two text parts to content 'First resultSecond result'.
The recorded base's existing normalization suite passed 4 tests.
At the exact candidate commit, all 7 focused tests passed, including its exact text-array, empty-array, and mixed-array expectations.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-55e34908484f/venv/bin/python -c '<validate and normalize image-only, file-only, and mixed function output lists>'
tests.what_was_measured: At the exact candidate commit, schema-valid image-only and file-only outputs normalized to an empty string; a text-image-text list normalized to 'beforeafter', discarding the image.
The environment exposes exactly one AMD Instinct MI350X device with capability 9.5 under PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned single gfx950 GPU was detected, but model/GPU execution was not needed for the deterministic normalization counterexample and was not run independently in this review.

remaining_counterexamples: A schema-valid function_call_output containing only an input_image part is converted to an empty tool-message string.
A schema-valid function_call_output containing only an input_file part is converted to an empty tool-message string.
A schema-valid mixed text/image/text output silently removes the image and concatenates the surrounding text without a separator.
remaining_limitations: The exact issue payload could not be reproduced as failing on the required recorded base because that base already contains text-array flattening.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights and its deepseekv4/reasoning parser, DSPARK, and production launch configuration were unavailable.
No HTTP model server was launched; the independent counterexamples exercise request schema validation and the actual checked-out normalization implementation directly.
The environment is ROCm gfx950, not the issue's CUDA environment, and no multi-node or distributed behavior was tested.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
